title: Understanding the Problem
text: The problem involves comparing two linear regression models: one using the original design matrix X and the other using the mean-centered design matrix X̃. The goal is to determine under what conditions the coefficients from these models are equal.

title: Mean-Centering Effect
text: Mean-centering affects the intercept term in a linear regression model. However, it does not affect the other coefficients if the design matrix has full column rank.

title: Intercept Term
text: When you mean-center the data, the intercept term is adjusted to account for the mean of the response variable. This adjustment does not affect the other coefficients.

title: Comparing Coefficients
text: Given that mean-centering affects only the intercept, are the coefficients for the other variables in the models using X and X̃ the same?
